name: Tablet Lite
author: maxt
description: The tablet core, nothing else: the on-screen keyboard (wvkbd-deskintl with a visible ▼ collapse key, also on the lock screen), a hold-to-talk button for Omarchy's own dictation (omarchy dictation), and screen rotation — auto (sensor) by default plus fixed 0°/90°/180°/270°, with the touch calibration matrix kept in step. Everything Omarchy 4.5 already provides (dictation backends and their lock, the OSD, the theme colors, the lock state) is used as-is instead of being re-implemented.

barWidget.description: On-screen keyboard toggle + hold-to-talk for omarchy dictation + ONE rotation button opening a picker (auto default, 0°/90°/180°/270°); folds into one popup button in portrait
